ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلطُّورِ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالطُّوْرِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: By the mount
ayahs.transliteration: Wat-toor
ayahs.translationClear: By the Mount.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكِتٰبٍ مَّسْطُوْرٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [by] a Book inscribed[1550]
ayahs.transliteration: Wakitaabim mastoor

footnotes.1550: Interpreted as the Preserved Slate or possibly the Qur’ān.

ayahs.translationClear: And a Book inscribed.

ayahs.textUthmani: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فِيْ رَقٍّ مَّنْشُوْرٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: In parchment spread open
ayahs.transliteration: Fee raqqim manshoor
ayahs.translationClear: In a published scroll.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُوْرِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [by] the frequented House[1551]
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-baytil-ma'moor

footnotes.1551: The house of worship for the angels in the seventh heaven, comparable to the Kaʿbah on earth.

ayahs.translationClear: And the frequented House.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوْعِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
ayahs.transliteration: Was-saqfil-marfoo'i
ayahs.translationClear: And the elevated roof.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُوْرِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [by] the sea set on fire,[1552]
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-bahril-masjoor

footnotes.1552: On the Day of Resurrection. Or "the sea which has overflowed."

ayahs.translationClear: And the seething sea.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna 'adhaaba rabbika lawaaqi'
ayahs.translationClear: The punishment of your Lord is coming.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: مَّا لَهٗ مِنْ دَافِعٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.transliteration: Maa lahoo min daafi'
ayahs.translationClear: There is nothing to avert it.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: يَّوْمَ تَمُوْرُ السَّمَا࢜ءُ مَوْرًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tamoorus-samaa'u mawraa
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the heaven sways in agitation.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّتَسِيْرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will pass on, departing[1553] -
ayahs.transliteration: Wataseerul-jibaalu sayraa

footnotes.1553: Becoming dust and moving as clouds.

ayahs.translationClear: And the mountains go into motion.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَوَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.transliteration: Fawaylun yawma'idhil lilmukadhdhibeen
ayahs.translationClear: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ فِيْ خَوْضٍ يَّلْعَبُوْنَ ۘ
ayahs.translation: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena hum fee khawdin yal'aboon
ayahs.translationClear: Those who play with speculation.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّوْنَ اِلٰي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا ؕ
ayahs.translation: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yuda''oona ilaa naari jahannama da''aa
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when they are shoved into the Fire of Hell forcefully.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
ayahs.transliteration: Haadhihin-naarul-latee kuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon
ayahs.translationClear: “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَسِحْرٌ هٰذَا͏ٓ اَمْ اَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
ayahs.transliteration: Afasihrun haadhaa am antum laa tubsiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Is this magic, or do you not see?

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ‌ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوْٓا اَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْاۚ سَوَا࢜ءٌ عَلَيْكُمْؕ اِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: Islawhaa fasbiroo aw laa tasbiroo sawaa'un 'alaykum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: Burn in it. Whether you are patient, or impatient, it is the same for you. You are only being repaid for what you used to do.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِيْمٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
ayahs.transliteration: Innal-muttaqeena fee jannaatin wana'eem
ayahs.translationClear: But the righteous will be amid gardens and bliss.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فٰكِهِيْنَ بِمَا͏ٓ اٰتٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْۚ وَوَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
ayahs.transliteration: Faakiheena bimaa aataahum rabbuhum wawaqaahum rabbuhum 'adhaabal-jaheem
ayahs.translationClear: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord has spared them the suffering of Hell.

ayahs.textUthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: كُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا هَنِيْ࢜ـٔ͏ًاۢ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: Kuloo washraboo hanee'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: Eat and drink happily, for what you used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ‌ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: مُتَّكِـِٕيْنَ عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوْفَةٍۚ وَزَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatin wazawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een
ayahs.translationClear: Relaxing on luxurious furnishings; and We will couple them with gorgeous spouses.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ‌ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِاِيْمَانٍ اَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا͏ٓ اَلَتْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍؕ كُلُّ امْرِىٍٔۢ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِيْنٌ
ayahs.translation: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.[1554] Every person, for what he earned, is retained.[1555]
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wattaba'at'hum dhurriyyatuhum bi'eemaanin alhaqnaa bihim dhurriyyatahum wamaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shay'in kullumri'im bimaa kasaba raheen

footnotes.1555: i.e., subject or held responsible. Literally, "a hostage."

ayahs.translationClear: Those who believed, and their offspring followed them in faith—We will unite them with their offspring, and We will not deprive them of any of their works. Every person is hostage to what he has earned.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمْدَدْنٰهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'amdadnaahum bifaakihatin walahmim mimmaa yashtahoon
ayahs.translationClear: And We will supply them with fruit, and meat; such as they desire.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يَتَنَازَعُوْنَ فِيْهَا كَاْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيْهَا وَلَا تَاْثِيْمٌ

words.translation: They will pass to one another

ayahs.translation: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
ayahs.transliteration: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa ka'sal laa laghwun feehaa walaa ta'theem
ayahs.translationClear: They will exchange therein a cup; wherein is neither harm, nor sin.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَطُوْفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَاَنَّهُمْ لُو͏ٔ͏ْلُو͏ٔ͏ٌ مَّكْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.translation: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayatoofu 'alayhim ghilmaanul lahum ka'annahum lu'lu'um maknoon
ayahs.translationClear: Serving them will be youths like hidden pearls.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰي بَعْضٍ يَّتَسَا࢜ءَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din yatasaa'aloon
ayahs.translationClear: And they will approach one another, inquiring.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِيْٓ اَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo innaa kunnaa qablu fee ahlinaa mushfiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “Before this, we were fearful for our families.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقٰىنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
ayahs.transliteration: Famannallaahu 'alaynaa wawaqaanaa 'adhaabas-samoom
ayahs.translationClear: But Allah blessed us, and spared us the agony of the Fiery Winds.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوْهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, we used to supplicate[1556] Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal-barrur-raheem
ayahs.translationClear: Before this, we used to pray to Him. He is the Good, the Compassionate.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّلَا مَجْنُوْنٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
ayahs.transliteration: Fadhakkir famaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahinin walaa majnoon
ayahs.translationClear: So remind. By the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَيْبَ الْمَنُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?[1557]
ayahs.transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raybal-manoon

footnotes.1557: i.e., some accident or inevitable death.

ayahs.translationClear: Or do they say, “A poet—we await for him a calamity of time”?

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوْا فَاِنِّيْ مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fa'innee ma'akum minal-mutarabbiseen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Go on waiting; I will be waiting with you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ‌ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ تَاْمُرُهُمْ اَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهٰذَا͏ٓ اَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Or do their minds[1558] command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
ayahs.transliteration: Am ta'muruhum ahlaamuhum bihaadhaa am hum qawmun taaghoon

footnotes.1558: In this expression is also a subtle allusion to the leaders of the Quraysh, who considered themselves to be great minds.

ayahs.translationClear: Or is it that their dreams compel them to this? Or are they aggressive people?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ‌ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗۚ بَلْ لَّا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahoo bal laa yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they say, “He made it up”? Rather, they do not believe.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلْيَاْتُوْا بِحَدِيْثٍ مِّثْلِهٖٓ اِنْ كَانُوْا صٰدِقِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.transliteration: Falya'too bihadeethim mithlihee in kaanoo saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: So let them produce a discourse like it, if they are truthful.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ خُلِقُوْا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ اَمْ هُمُ الْخٰلِقُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
ayahs.transliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shay'in am humul-khaaliqoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ‌ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَۚ بَلْ لَّا يُوْقِنُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
ayahs.transliteration: Am khalaqus-samaawaati wal-arda bal laa yooqinoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَا࢜ىِٕنُ رَبِّكَ اَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَۜيْطِرُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
ayahs.transliteration: Am 'indahum khazaa'inu rabbika am humul-musaytiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ‌ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَّسْتَمِعُوْنَ فِيْهِۚ فَلْيَاْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
ayahs.transliteration: Am lahum sullamun yastami'oona feehi falya'ti mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear proof.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَهُ الْبَنٰتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
ayahs.transliteration: Am lahul-banaatu walakumul-banoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or for Him the daughters, and for you the sons?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ تَسْـٔ͏َلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.transliteration: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim muthqaloon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do you demand a payment from them, and they are burdened by debt?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.transliteration: Am 'indahumul-ghaybu fahum yaktuboon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they know the future, and they are writing it down?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا‌ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ يُرِيْدُوْنَ كَيْدًاؕ فَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا هُمُ الْمَكِيْدُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
ayahs.transliteration: Am yureedoona kaydan fal-ladheena kafaroo humul-makeedoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or are they planning a conspiracy? The conspiracy will befall the disbelievers.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ اِلٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللّٰهِؕ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: Am lahum ilaahun ghayrullaahi subhaanallaahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they have a god besides Allah? Allah transcends what they associate.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا كِسْفًا مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ سَاقِطًا يَّقُوْلُوْا سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُوْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,[1559] they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in yaraw kisfam minas-samaa'i saaqitan yaqooloo sahaabum markoom

footnotes.1559: Marking the onset of Allāh's punishment, as they had requested.

ayahs.translationClear: Even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوْا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِيْ فِيْهِ يُصْعَقُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
ayahs.transliteration: Fadharhum hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee feehi yus'aqoon
ayahs.translationClear: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be stunned.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِيْ عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kayduhum shay'an walaa hum yunsaroon
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when their ploys will avail them nothing; and they will not be helped.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا عَذَابًا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment[1560] before that, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'inna lilladheena zalamoo 'adhaaban doona dhaalika walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon

footnotes.1560: If not in this world, in the grave.

ayahs.translationClear: For those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that; but most of them do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا‌ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِيْنَ تَقُوْمُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
ayahs.transliteration: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa'innaka bi'a'yuninaa wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom
ayahs.translationClear: So patiently await the decision of your Lord, for you are before Our eyes; and proclaim the praises of your Lord when you arise.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاِدْبَارَ النُّجُوْمِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
ayahs.transliteration: Waminal-layli fasabbihhu wa'idbaaran-nujoom
ayahs.translationClear: And glorify Him during the night, and at the receding of the stars.
